name: floor
prompt: Use the attached catalogue ONLY for the visual style of panel 01 at the TOP LEFT: clean blue-gray ancient dungeon stone, strong readable planar pixel clusters, restrained cracks, subdued slate highlights, NO moss or vegetation. Create a professional game texture: a perfectly FLAT TOP-DOWN ORTHOGRAPHIC square sheet of continuous fitted stone dungeon floor filling the ENTIRE image edge to edge. This is the unprojected material to be mapped onto a game's 4:3 isometric floor later, so NO isometric view, NO visible side faces, NO raised slabs, NO perspective, NO scene or objects. Approximately EIGHT large flagstones across and EIGHT down, 64 logical paving modules occupying one uninterrupted floor. Each main paving module is broad and quiet, with only a few secondary chips or short hairline cracks. Neighboring stones share snug, consistent mortar seams; no gaps, no black-outline outlines around every tiny chip. Some slabs contain a single subtle split, most are intact. Natural irregular joints, but clear large-scale square paving rather than small cobbles. The reference 01's material is authoritative. Much less noisy than a photographic texture, no grain, no isolated sparkling pixels, no grates, no circles, no grass, no stains shaped like symbols. Soft restrained baked ambient shading, same brightness across entire image, no spotlight, no vignette, no directional room lighting. Deliberately hand-drawn high-quality PIXEL ART with clean 3-6 pixel clusters at native1024; not smooth painting or 3D-rendered bricks. Square 1024x1024 texture, edges seamless when repeated horizontally and vertically. Absolutely no margins, border, text, labels, numbers, transparency, shadows, props or walls. Surface should look like the floor material inside panel01, ready to form one cohesive room rather than a collage of separate tile previews.

name: masonry
prompt: Use ONLY the stone material style of the TOP-LEFT panel01 in the attached catalogue. Create a separate professionally hand-drawn PIXEL ART material for the VERTICAL SIDE FACES of its ancient stone dungeon platforms and solid masonry walls. Critical: perfectly flat FRONT ELEVATION facing the masonry straight on, no isometric view, no perspective, no visible top surface, no corners, no floor, no objects. The image is an opaque square1024x1024 texture filled edge-to-edge with horizontal staggered courses of chunky rectangular blue-gray slate masonry. Approximately EIGHT blocks across each row and SIXTEEN courses high; each block is about twice as wide as it is high. Alternating half-block offset at the left/right border. Broad quiet stone faces, slightly chipped edges, restrained dark mortar, a few small cracks; clean legible pixel clusters, no photorealistic grain. Perfect seamless repetition at ALL FOUR image borders, first and last courses compatible. No frame, no captions, no symbols, no decorations, no transparent pixels. The game will repeat this material at a constant scale on variable-height walls, so do not bake a fixed wall height or top/bottom cap into the artwork. Native1024 pixel art, flat square texture, NOT a tile presentation sheet.
